notes.title: Game updates and new demo
notes.content:
As Glacial was the first full game i had developed, since its time of release i have learnt a lot in ways to improve the player experience. What changes have been made?


- New area has been added to the map.

- The camera effects have been completely re-done, creating a more visually 
pleasing experience for the player.

- Two new scares have been added to the game.

- An objective system is now in place, helping give the player direction.

- An option to turn off enemys and player deaths has been added, allowing those who prefer a more casual style of horror to enjoy the game.

- Improved optimisation , the cameras range has been decreased creating higher frame rates and a smoother player experience. 

- A free demo has been added allowing you to play the first section of the game, or until the player has decided if this game is for them.
